title: Siman 440
section: The Virtue of Hisbodidus — Secluded Personal Prayer

segments.he: לְעִנְיַןשְׁבִירַת תַּאֲווֹת וּמִדּוֹת רָעוֹת לְגַמְרֵי בְּתַכְלִית הַבִּטּוּל שֶׁהִתְפָּאֵר אֶת עַצְמוֹ שֶׁזָּכָה לָזֶה, אָמַר רַבֵּנוּ
segments.en: (4.) He said: "Even when one cannot speak in hisbodidus — only the two words 'Master of the Universe' [Ribono Shel Olam] — that too is very good." He said that one can recognize in another person whether he has hisbodidus.
